messages:
Luis (security): Heads-up: partner integration surfaced 2 asks: long-window SIEM pulls and an API for ad-hoc historical batches. Need to confirm RBAC + KMS unwrap controls before we greenlight.
Aria (cloud-infra): Can we block direct Decrypt on the KMS CMK for the partner role? They should only receive data keys via GenerateDataKey.
Luis (security): Yes. Principle: no principal should have Decrypt on export CMKs. Use envelope keys + grants.
Sasha (oncall): From an ops POV 90d default retention, 365d opt-in for security/legal only. Any historical pull should create an export record and set an incident-like ticket for traceability.
Devon (legal): GDPR note: EU-subject logs with identifiers require minimization/tokenization unless explicit legal hold. Any 365d justification must include business case + retention review cadence.
Aria (cloud-infra): Proposed flow: export service writes encrypted blobs to S3 with metadata (residency, schema, tier). Partner calls export API -> we create timeboxed KMS grant + pre-signed URL to blob. Grant auto-revokes after TTL.
Aria (cloud-infra): pseudo: ```sh
aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/EXPORT --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::PARTNER:role/exporter --operations GenerateDataKey --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"export_id":"EX-123"} --retiring-principal arn:aws:iam::REVOKER
```
Luis (security): Important: every create-grant & GenerateDataKey must be logged to security-telemetry and correlated with a ticket ID. No manual unwraps.
kms-bot: Event mapping added: kms.create_grant -> telemetry.event=siem_export.grant_created; kms.generate_data_key -> telemetry.event=siem_export.gdk; kms.decrypt -> telemetry.event=siem_export.unwrap_attempt.
Sasha (oncall): Alert rules: if an account creates >5 grants for different export_ids in 10m, fire high-sev. Also alert on grants with TTL > 4h.
Devon (legal): Add policy: exports with user PII must include redaction summary and the redaction method (tokenize/hash). Legal review required for raw exports.
Luis (security): RBAC proposal:
- role/siem_exporter: can Read S3 objects only when a grant exists
- group/security_approvers: can approve retention overrides and unwraps
- group/compliance_approvers: second approver for EU or PII exports
(approvals must be recorded in ticket)
Aria (cloud-infra): Automation task: create lambda to provision grants + schedule auto-retire. Will attach IAM policy templates in PR.
Luis (security): Runbook addendum: treat any unexpected grant retirements or failed unwraps as potential compromise; escalate to sec-oncall and rotate CMK if suspicious. Link: https://redwood.example/runbooks/siem-export.
Sasha (oncall): We should surface export job traces to traces-service for 180d to enable forensic replay without unwrapping keys repeatedly. Keeps unwraps rarer.
Devon (legal): Can ops provide a redaction checklist? Need fields that must be removed for EU subjects (email, ip, user_id) and acceptable tokenization schemes.
Luis (security): Action items: Aria -> PR with automation & IAM, Sasha -> alerting + traces retention, Devon -> redaction checklist, Luis -> RFC + JIRA SEC-TRIAGE-117. Target: pilot in 21 days.
Aria (cloud-infra): Will spin up a sandbox integration and share logs. Expect a draft PR by EOD Friday.
Luis (security): Thanks all. Keeping this thread open until RFC merged.
